spellbook.finance/limitations: Archetype share represents observed event decklists, not the whole player population or future demand.
Unknown archetype, missing prices and incomplete event coverage stay explicit through null values, missingFields and limitations.
Format rotation legality is not inferred from observed decklists.

description: Read observed Pokemon archetype and card facts for one format and exact archetype name from recent Limitless tournament decklists. The response preserves source coverage, card prices, truncation, missingFields and limitations. It reports observations and does not recommend a deck or purchase.

limit.description: Maximum cards to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 100.
